sources.note: Main vendor homepage. Describes OmniMD as all-in-one EHR, billing, and AI solutions platform. Mentions 20+ years experience, serves small practices to multi-location systems.

ONC transparency page. Lists products including EHR, AI-powered tools (AI Front Desk, AI Medical Scribe, AI RCM, AI Clinician), practice management, medical billing, digital health, lab interface software. No pricing details visible.
About page. Light on detail — confirms Hawthorne NY headquarters, 20+ years experience, support contact info. No founding story, leadership details, or customer stats on extracted content.
EHR product page. High-level marketing: streamlines workflows, speeds charting, maximizes revenue. Light on specific feature details in extracted content.
Patient portal page. Describes 24/7 health record access, appointment scheduling, secure messaging, online billing, real-time medical information access.
Practice management page. Cloud-based PMS with claims management, patient flow automation, daily operations streamlining. Light on specific feature detail.
Digital health page. Mentions digital health platform but extracted content was mostly structural/CSS with minimal feature description.
Billing services page. Describes RCM services, maximize collections, reduce errors. Thin on specific feature details.
Specialties overview page. Claims support for 40+ medical specialties with specialty-specific workflows, documentation, and billing. Individual specialties not enumerated in extracted content.

Third-party review site. 4/5 stars (36 reviews). Lists features: patient portal, billing/RCM, scheduling, e-prescribing, lab integration (Labcorp, Quest), telemedicine, mobile app. Specialties: cardiology, podiatry, OB/GYN, pediatrics, urology. Notes free EHR with billing services.

Third-party review site. 4/5 (6 reviews). Notes developed by Integrated Systems Management. Lists pricing at $109/user. Certifications: MU Stage 2, ONC-ATCB, SureScripts, EHNAC EPCSCP. User reviews mention psychiatric and integrative medicine use. Mixed feedback on reporting and support.

Third-party review site. 4.1/5 (43 reviews, 79% positive). Pricing from $250/month/user. Features: AI documentation, voice recognition, automated claim scrubbing, FHIR integration, LIS/RIS compatibility, iOS/Android apps. Specialties: primary care, dermatology, cardiology, orthopedics, urgent care, nephrology, podiatry, internal medicine, psychiatry, pediatrics.
